text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a gap in audit logs when requests are routed through delegated service tokens. Example: org A creates a delegated token to call proj B, but CloudTrail shows only the delegator project, not the original service account.
chad: ugh, yeah this is the token-forwarding thing we chatted about. Do you have an example request/headers?
maria: minimal repro:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer svc-deleg-xxxx
X-Forwarded-For-Org: org-A
```
And the audit entry: `actor.project=proj-b` only — missing `actor.origin_sa`.
tess: is this only for cross-project delegation or also for org->project routed keys?
maria: so far repro'd for both, but more frequent when we hit proxy route that does token-impersonation for quota attribution.
samir: quick theory: when we mint an ephemeral on behalf of the delegator we overwrite `Actor` fields in the log emitter. telemetry currently reads from the in-flight token claim instead of `original_claim` in the ctx.
ops-bot: alert: authz-mismatch spike detected in /v1/generate latency window 09:12-09:18, grouped by proj-b (125 events).
chad: sounds like two fixes: 1) stop dropping original issuer metadata in the proxy during mint 2) add fallback enrichment that writes `original_actor` to audit payload. Which is lower risk for a canary?
tess: (1) requires touching minting path + KMS calls — medium risk. (2) is just adding extra fields to audit events downstream — lower risk, immediate. But (2) won't fix attribution for quota routing decisions in real-time.
pm-elena: from product: we need accurate billing attribution ASAP. If we delay, customers could be billed to wrong project. Can we gate (1) behind a rollout flag and do (2) as short term?
samir: agree. plan suggestion: implement audit enrichment (2) in telemetry service -> roll out to 10% first. Parallel: change proxy to propagate `x-original-sa` header when creating ephemeral, but keep behavior behind feature flag for Dedicated customers.
chad: also add an alert rule for authz-attribution-{metric} if discrepancy between `billing_project` and `audit.actor.project` > 0.5% over 5m.
maria: note: console shows API keys page with "Last used by" pointing to proj-b right now — that UI reads current token claim, so will be inconsistent until we fix. We should not roll out console change until audit is fixed or we add the derived field.
samir: I'll open a small PR to telemetry that enriches events with `original_issuer` when present and add unit tests. Will include a pprof to ensure no perf hit.
chad: for the proxy change I'll stub header pass-through and add a canary in staging. ping @deploy-bot when ready.
deploy-bot: scheduling canary deploy to staging at 2026-04-07T15:30:00Z. (will notify channels).
pm-elena: thanks — please add a short blurb for customer-facing changelog explaining "improved audit attribution for delegated tokens" so customer success can triage billing questions.
tess: one more: telemetry schema needs a migration: add optional `original_issuer` string. No downstream consumers should fail when missing. Samir, can you add schema doc?
samir: yup. will add docs + rollout doc in the PR. ETA EOD.
maria: awesome — thanks team. once canary looks good let's schedule a prod rollout and a console patch to prefer `original_issuer` when displaying "Last used by". :thumbsup:
